build.reason: The recipe builds the library and links its static archive into this target; the selected parser change has no compile-time guard in the supplied function.

lifecycle.reason: For the reachable early-exit path, parser and emitter initialization precede use, and cleanup deletes both objects and copied events.

control_flow.reason: The harness treats a successful copy as a reason to leave the parse loop. A stream-start copy returns success, so emission and later parse calls are skipped on a valid YAML stream.

accepted.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no other parse loop or call sequence that reaches the added branch after this exit.
